## University of Melbourne

```{=html}
<div class="teach-entry">
<div class="teach-title">Econometrics of Markets and Competition (ECOM40007/90017)</div>
<div class="teach-period">2024 &ndash; Present</div>
<div class="teach-desc">ECOM40007/90017 covers empirical industrial organization at the Honours undergraduate and Masters level. Topics include differentiated product demand estimation (Berry 1994; BLP), merger simulations, auctions, search, static entry models, and production function estimation.</div>
</div>

<div class="teach-entry">
<div class="teach-title">Competition and Strategy (ECON20005)</div>
<div class="teach-period">2024 &ndash; Present</div>
<div class="teach-desc">ECON20005 is a second-year elective that introduces students to game theory and its applications in everyday life, as well as the analysis of firms&rsquo; strategic behavior and competition.</div>
</div>

<div class="teach-entry">
<div class="teach-title">Computational Economics (ECON90055)</div>
<div class="teach-period">2023 &ndash; 2025</div>
<div class="teach-desc">ECON90055 introduces modern computational methods to solve and estimate structural models, analyze spatial and other datasets, and apply these tools to economic research.</div>
</div>
```
